name: Chadian Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Fresh parsley or mint leaves, chopped (optional, for garnish)

steps: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, red onion, and carrot in a mixing bowl.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper to make a dressing. Adjust the seasoning according to your taste.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables in the mixing bowl. Gently toss the salad to ensure all the vegetables are coated with the dressing.
Cover the mixing bowl with plastic wrap or a lid and let the salad marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. This allows the flavors to blend together and enhances the taste.
Remove the salad from the refrigerator. Give it a final toss to mix the flavors, and transfer it to a serving dish. If desired, sprinkle chopped parsley or mint leaves on top as a garnish.
Enjoy as a standalone dish or as a side salad alongside grilled meats, fish, or other main courses.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
